en: The image shows the reverse side of a mailed postcard. There is a red Lithuanian postage stamp with the word 'LIETUVA' and a postmark. The card is divided into an address section on the right and a message written in cursive on the left and bottom. The address is written in Latin script, and the message appears to be in Estonian. A date is written near the top of the message.
